personal_information.description: Graphic & UI/UX Designer with 5+ years crafting brand identities, digital campaigns, and user-centered interfaces. Experienced working with agencies and startups to translate business goals into compelling visual stories. Passionate about clean layouts, strong typography, and meaningful design that drives results.

description: Majored in Visual Communication Design with focus on branding and digital media.
Graduated with honours, thesis on user experience in e-commerce interfaces.
Active member of the ITB Design Community, led annual design exhibition.
Lead design for 3 major SaaS products, improving user retention by 35% through redesigned onboarding flows.
Conduct user research, usability testing, and A/B testing to validate design decisions.
Collaborate with developers using Figma handoff and design systems to ensure pixel-perfect implementation.
Mentored 2 junior designers and established the team's design review process.
Created brand identities for 20+ clients across F&B, fashion, and tech industries.
Designed social media content calendars reaching 500K+ combined audience.
Produced print materials including packaging, brochures, and event collateral.
Won internal award for best brand refresh project (2021).

projects.title: Rasa Nusantara — F&B Brand Identity
projects.description: Full brand identity design for a traditional Indonesian restaurant chain, including logo, color palette, packaging, and menu design. Increased brand recognition by 40% post-launch.

projects.title: PayEase — Mobile App Redesign
projects.description: UX audit and full redesign of a fintech mobile app. Reduced user drop-off at checkout by 28% and improved App Store rating from 3.2 to 4.6.

projects.title: Gaya Hijab — E-Commerce Visual Campaign
projects.description: Designed a seasonal campaign for a modest fashion brand, producing 60+ social media assets, email templates, and banner ads that drove a 55% sales increase during Ramadan.
